My great break days after long works
Aug 2026 • Solo
There is a wonderful bar name Go 2 Bar, located in Bui Vien Walking Street, I have to say, at night, this whole Walking street is like a Big House Party, full of loud musics, the girls, and of course Beers and Foods. But I prefered the coziness and silence so I came in the morning to have some coffee. I would say Go 2 Bar is a wonderful bar, the employees are generous and kind, they help me with everything they can, Managers are lovely, they know exactly what I need even I haven't ask yet. So I have some coffee, then I called some foods. The Pizzas...... Uhmmm It's the super delicious, I can called it was a Gift from God. No Pizzas in the whole areas can compared to them. It was the best Pizza I ever ate. The Chef is professional, the Pizza is crunchy enough, not too rough, cheese is great, no cons. The Cocktails are beautiful, well decorated and delicious. The bar have a very wide view so that you can have a look at the whole center view. It's wonderful. I will definitely coming back here when I have time. 100% and 100 points. ❤❤❤❤❤
